title: Variables

story.introduction:
MENTOR-9 pulls up a holographic display showing the ship's memory banks.

"Your communication circuits work, PROTO-7, but now we need to check memory. Can you store data? Retrieve it? Variables are how robots remember things."

The display flickers, showing variables as glowing containers holding different types of data.
story.context: Variables are containers that hold data during test execution. Robot Framework supports scalars (single values), lists (ordered collections), and dictionaries (key-value pairs).

learningObjectives: Use Set Variable keyword to store data
Understand variable naming rules and case sensitivity
Apply variable flexibility vs keyword flexibility
